descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste se rapporte à :

Division CFO Smart Buildings

Gestionnaire de la Division du SIS ELSB

Emplacement

C'est un rôle mondial. Le candidat peut être basé partout dans le monde, de préférence en Europe et à proximité d'une usine ELSB.

Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez la fonction de systèmes d'information (SI) de la Division des bâtiments intelligents, façonnant et exécutant la division. Vous serez responsable de l'architecture de SI de la division, de la feuille de route technologique et du portefeuille de projets, assurant la prestation de services de SI sécuritaires, fiables et axés sur les entreprises.

Vous dirigerez la modernisation, la simplification et la normalisation du paysage IS de la division, tout en maintenant l'alignement sur l'architecture d'entreprise d'ABB, les normes de gouvernance et les exigences de cybersécurité. En partenariat étroit avec les intervenants du secteur des affaires et de la technologie, vous identifierez les possibilités de tirer parti des technologies numériques, d'optimiser les investissements dans les SI et de maximiser la valeur offerte par les solutions technologiques.

En tant que membre de l'équipe de leadership des SI, vous établirez de solides relations dans l'ensemble de l'organisation, influencerez les décisions stratégiques et favoriserez la collaboration entre les fonctions des SI et celles des entreprises. Vous dirigerez, développerez et inspirerez également une équipe de SI hautement performante, favorisant une culture d'innovation, de responsabilisation, d'amélioration continue et de centrage client.
Ce rôle contribue à la division des bâtiments intelligents au sein de l'électrification. Les principaux intervenants sont Équipe de leadership de la Division, gestionnaire des SI d'électrification et gestion directe des SI d'ELSB.

• Responsabilités

  • Stratégie et architecture du SIS: Élaborer une stratégie et une architecture du SIS pour la Division des bâtiments intelligents en harmonie avec la stratégie opérationnelle de la Division, et une stratégie plus large du SIS et de l'architecture d'entreprise de l'ABB. Favoriser la modernisation et la simplification du paysage des SI de division dans le cadre du programme ABB DSM, et appuyer les initiatives de normalisation des données.

  • IS Mise en oeuvre: Propre et assurer la prestation réussie du portefeuille distinct de projets de SI de la division, et des projets communs et de base ayant une incidence sur la Division des bâtiments intelligents. Fournir des bâtiments intelligents a fourni des services de SI, à la fois distincts et communs (par exemple, les services de SI de pays en Allemagne, en Arabie saoudite ainsi que Salesforce.com pour l'ensemble d'ABB), et s'assurer que les services de SI de base et communs reçus sont conformes aux SLA convenus. Favoriser l'amélioration continue et faciliter le partage des pratiques exemplaires.

  • Politiques et sécurité de l'information du SISadhésion: Assurer le respect de l'architecture d'entreprise ABB IS, des politiques et des règlements pertinents IS. Assurer la gouvernance de la sécurité de l'information, la gestion des risques et la conformité dans l'ensemble de la division.

  • Budget et contrôle financier : Contrôler le budget, les dépenses et l'affectation des coûts des SI, en assurant l'exactitude financière et la transparence pour optimiser les dépenses contrôlables des SI et assurer des investissements à valeur ajoutée.

  • Personnes Leadership et perfectionnement : Assurez-vous que votre région est bien organisée, dotée de personnel, compétente et dirigée. Guider, motiver et développer des subordonnés directs et indirects, en faisant preuve d'un leadership fort animé par la collaboration, la transparence et le savoir-faire technique en matière de SI.

• Qualifications

  • Baccalauréat en technologie de l'information, en génie, en informatique, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe; maîtrise préférée.

  • Minimum de 10 ans d'expérience dans une vaste gamme de disciplines en technologie de l'information

  • Expérience éprouvée à diriger des équipes, des projets et des initiatives d'information et de technologie de l'information dans un environnement mondial complexe, capable de former, de développer, de motiver et de diriger des équipes à haut rendement dans de multiples endroits et cultures.

  • Chef stratégique de la technologie possédant de solides compétences analytiques, traduisant les besoins des entreprises en solutions technologiques efficaces et en feuilles de route alignées sur les objectifs de l'entreprise.

  • Compétence en gestion financière, en portefeuilles de technologie, en budgets et en partenariats avec les fournisseurs pour maximiser le rendement opérationnel et le rendement opérationnel.

  • Collaborateur influent et communicateur, établissant de solides relations avec les intervenants et favorisant l'harmonisation entre les équipes d'affaires et de technologie.

  • Agent de changement axé sur les résultats, dirigeant l'adoption de la technologie, l'amélioration continue et l'excellence opérationnelle, tout en produisant des résultats opérationnels mesurables.

Cette possibilité est ouverte aux candidats dans plusieurs pays, le lieu de travail final étant déterminé en fonction du candidat sélectionné. jobs.title: R&D Project Manager (f/m/d) 80-100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Manager Critical Power

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will develop and design products, systems, and technologies by leading and managing one or more R&D projects to achieve project objectives. You will coordinate the work of local and cross-functional project teams and provide leadership in collaboration with local managers, steering committees, product management, and external partners to ensure value creation.

Work model: On-site

Your key responsibilities

  • Project Leadership: Plan, organize, and lead projects; assign tasks; motivate cross-functional teams; and apply project management methodologies and decision-making processes.

  • Execution Management: Monitor project milestones, track costs, and manage changes and claims in accordance with defined processes.

  • Risk & Quality Management: Identify and mitigate risks, oversee prototyping activities, and ensure on-time project delivery.

  • Stakeholder Management: Foster effective communication across project teams and maintain strong relationships with internal functions, R&D teams, customers, and external partners.

  • Reporting: Prepare comprehensive project reports and monitor financial performance.

You will be part of an international team at our Technology Center and collaborate with global research centers and external stakeholders.

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in project management, combined with experience as a development engineer.

  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies with a proven track record of successful application.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English.

  • Comprehensive technical expertise in the development of low-voltage products, including mechanical and electrical systems, product design, and assembly processes.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project), with experience in CAD software such as SolidWorks considered an advantage.

  • Self-driven, quick to learn, solution-oriented, and experienced in collaborating with global suppliers, engineering teams, and manufacturing locations.

About Us

ABB Smart Buildings is transforming commercial, industrial, and residential buildings through digitalization, delivering greater comfort, efficiency, safety, and security. jobs.title: Group Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Senior Digital Communications Manager

__

As Group Social Media Manager you will be the driving force behind our brand's presence across the Group social media channels, sitting at the corporate team of a large, highly decentralized organization. You will be hands-on, bring creative instinct, a strategic thinker and know how to get things done with a high degree of collaboration with multiple stakeholders.

Working model: hybrid #LI-hybrid

• Responsibilities

  • Creating and publishing content. You will plan and post content developed by other colleagues and by you, across social media channels, including LinkedIn, Instagram, and X, ensuring ABB’s brand shows up consistently, relevantly, and with impact.

  • Repurposing and amplifying. You will work across the organization to surface the best of what they are already producing and reshape it for the Group social media channels.

  • Engage with our audience. You will monitor comments, messages, and mentions, ensuring we engage with our audience in a way that builds trust, fosters community, and builds and protects our reputation.

  • Create live moments. You will plan and execute regular live social media events, both topical and evergreen, around key company milestones and business priorities

  • Work with influencers. You will identify, engage, and manage relationships with influencers whose voice and audience align with our brand, co-creating content that extends our reach authentically and credibly.

  • Manage agencies and external partners. You will brief, coordinate, and hold the agencies we work with accountable, ensuring their output is always on brand, on brief, and on time.

  • Navigate a complex organization. You will collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, each with their own priorities, building alignment and buy-in. You will play a key role in driving our Social Media Community of Practice, where social media colleagues from across the company come together to connect, learn and grow together.

  • Protect and empower the organization. You will develop guidelines, toolkits, and trainings that equip colleagues to use social media confidently and responsibly, safeguarding our brand wherever it shows up online.

  • Measure and report. You will track performance across Group channels, turning data into clear insights and actionable recommendations that inform our strategy and demonstrate the value of social media to leadership.

• Qualifications / Experience / Skills

  • Approx 8-10 years of communications experience with at least 5 years of experience in social media management, ideally within a large, decentralized and complex organization.

  • Proven track record of managing social media channels end-to-end, from strategy to execution.

  • Degree in communications, marketing, journalism, or a related field.

  • Proficiency with social media and project management tools (e.g. Sprout Social, Asana, Talkwalker).

  • Experience working with and briefing agencies, as well as running influencer programs and partnerships.

  • Experience collaborating across multiple teams, geographies and business units. Able to build buy-in across a decentralized organization without formal authority.

  • Experience organizing social media live events. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities.

  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt tone and format across platforms.

  • Solid understanding of the major social media platforms and their respective best practices (LinkedIn, Instagram, X, and others).

  • Ability to repurpose and repackage content creatively from diverse sources.

  • Demonstrable awareness and sound judgment when it comes to reputational risk.

  • Proficiency with analytics platforms (Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence preferred)

  • Familiarity with basic content creation tools (e.g. Canva, Adobe)

  • Candidates must be eligible to work in Switzerland. Visa sponsorship is not offered for this position.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Senior Digital Communications Manager

Als Group Social Media Manager werden Sie die treibende Kraft hinter unseren Marken sein Präsenz über die Social-Media-Kanäle der Gruppe hinweg, sitzend im Unternehmensteam einer großen, stark dezentralen Organisation. Sie werden hands-on, bringen kreativen Instinkt, einen strategischen Denker und wissen, wie man Dinge mit einem hohen Maß an Zusammenarbeit mit mehreren Stakeholdern erledigt.

Arbeitsmodell: hybrid #LI-hybrid

• Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Erstellen und Veröffentlichen von Inhalten. Sie planen und posten Inhalte, die von anderen Kollegen und von Ihnen entwickelt wurden, über Social-Media-Kanäle, einschließlich LinkedIn, Instagram und X, um sicherzustellen, dass die Marke von ABB konsistent, relevant und mit Wirkung erscheint.

  • Verwendung und Verstärkung. Sie werden im gesamten Unternehmen daran arbeiten, das Beste aus dem, was sie bereits produzieren, herauszuholen und es für die Social-Media-Kanäle der Gruppe neu zu gestalten.

  • Mit unserem Publikum in Kontakt treten. Sie werden Kommentare, Nachrichten und Erwähnungen überwachen, um sicherzustellen, dass wir mit unserem Publikum in einer Weise interagieren, die Vertrauen schafft, die Gemeinschaft fördert und unseren Ruf aufbaut und schützt.

  • Erstellen Sie Live-Momente. Sie planen und führen regelmäßige Live-Social-Media-Events, sowohl aktuelle als auch immergrüne, rund um wichtige Meilensteine des Unternehmens und Geschäftsprioritäten aus

  • Arbeiten Sie mit Influencern. Sie identifizieren, engagieren und verwalten Beziehungen zu Influencern, deren Stimme und Publikum mit unserer Marke übereinstimmen, und erstellen gemeinsam Inhalte, die unsere Reichweite authentisch und glaubwürdig erweitern.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire principal des communications numériques

En tant que gestionnaire de médias sociaux de groupeVous serez le moteur de notre marque Présence dans les médias sociaux du Groupe, assis à l'équipe corporative d'une grande organisation hautement décentralisée.   • Création et publication du contenu. Vous planifierez et afficherez le contenu élaboré par d'autres collègues et par vous-même, sur les réseaux sociaux, y compris LinkedIn, Instagram et X, en veillant à ce que la marque d'ABB s'affiche de façon cohérente, pertinente et avec impact.

  • Réparer et amplifier. Vous travaillerez dans l'ensemble de l'organisation pour faire ressortir le meilleur de ce qu'ils produisent déjà et le remodeler pour les médias sociaux du Groupe.

  • Engager notre public. Vous surveillerez les commentaires, les messages et les mentions, en veillant à ce que nous intervenions avec notre auditoire d'une manière qui renforce la confiance, favorise la communauté et renforce et protège notre réputation.

  • Créer des moments en direct. Vous planifierez et exécuterez régulièrement des événements sur les médias sociaux, à la fois d'actualité et d'actualité, autour des grandes étapes de l'entreprise et des priorités commerciales

  • Travailler avec les influenceurs. Vous identifierez, engagerez et gérerez les relations avec les influenceurs dont la voix et le public s'harmonisent avec notre marque, co-créant du contenu qui étend notre portée authentique et crédible.

  • Gérer les agences et les partenaires externes. Vous informerez, coordonnerez et maintenirz les organismes avec lesquels nous travaillons, en veillant à ce que leur production soit toujours sur la marque, sur la brève et à temps.

  • Naviguer une organisation complexe. Vous collaborerez avec un large éventail d'intervenants, chacun ayant ses propres priorités, établissant l'alignement et l'adhésion.   • Protégez et autonomisez l'organisation. Vous élaborerez des lignes directrices, des trousses d'outils et des formations qui permettent aux collègues d'utiliser les médias sociaux avec confiance et responsabilité, en protégeant notre marque partout où elle apparaît en ligne.

  • Mesure et rapport. Vous suivrez le rendement à travers les canaux du Groupe, transformant les données en idées claires et en recommandations concrètes qui éclairent notre stratégie et démontrent la valeur des médias sociaux pour le leadership.

• Qualifications / Expérience / Compétences

  • Environ 8-10 ans d'expérience en communication avec au moins 5 années d'expérience en gestion des médias sociaux, idéalement au sein d'une grande organisation décentralisée et complexe.

  • Prouvé une expérience de la gestion des canaux de médias sociaux de bout en bout, de la stratégie à l'exécution.

  • Dépendance dans les communications, le marketing, le journalisme ou un domaine connexe.

  • Profit des médias sociaux et des outils de gestion de projets (p. ex., Sprout Social, Asana, Talkwalker).

  • Expérience en collaboration avec des organismes et des organismes d'information, en plus de gérer des programmes et des partenariats d'influenceurs.

  • Capacité d'intégrer une organisation décentralisée sans autorisation officielle.

  • Expérience à organiser des événements sur les médias sociaux en direct. Forte capacité de gestion de projet et d'organisation, avec la capacité de jongler avec plusieurs priorités.

  • De solides compétences en écriture et en narration, avec la capacité d'adapter le ton et le format à toutes les plateformes.

  • Compréhension solide des principales plateformes de médias sociaux et de leurs pratiques exemplaires respectives (LinkedIn, Instagram, X, et autres).

  • Capacité de réutiliser et de réemballer le contenu de façon créative à partir de sources diverses.

  • Soulignation et jugement manifestes quant au risque de réputation.

  • Profiabilité avec les plateformes analytiques (Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence préférée)

  • Familiarité avec les outils de création de contenu de base (p. ex. Canva, Adobe)

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Head of Mobile e-Power

__

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

As part of our strategic growth agenda, we are hiring a Global Mobile e‑Power Systems Manager for our Motion Traction business line.

Reporting to the Global Business Line Manager, Mobile e‑Power, this role is a key leadership position responsible for defining and driving the global product strategy, system architecture, and portfolio execution for electrified powertrain solutions in mining applications.

This is a global leadership role at the intersection of technology, product management, and business growth. You will lead a team of Product Managers and Mining Engineering specialists, shaping the future of electrified heavy-duty mobile equipment and delivering high-performance, scalable solutions for demanding environments.

This role is open globally, and preferred locations are set close to our main Motion Traction locations in Switzerland, Germany or Poland.

The work model is hybrid #LIhybrid.

Key • Responsibilities

  • Own the global product portfolio and lifecycle for mobile e‑power systems, ensuring competitiveness and long-term value creation

  • Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap, aligned with business growth objectives and market opportunities

  • Translate market trends, customer needs, and technology evolution into differentiated system-level offerings

  • Lead and develop a global team of Product Managers, fostering strong product ownership and market focus

  • Manage and steer a Mining Engineering team, driving technical excellence and application expertise

  • Define and oversee system architecture and integration across power converters, electric motors, battery systems, and control infrastructure

  • Engage with key global customers, OEMs, and strategic partners to shape value propositions and strengthen market positioning

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, Sales, Operations, and Service to drive innovation, portfolio execution, and business growth

• Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

  • At least 8+ years of experience in electrified powertrain systems, e‑mobility, or relevant industrial applications

  • Proven experience leading teams, such as Product Managers or senior engineering teams and developing people

  • Strong expertise in power electronics, including converters and inverters

  • Solid knowledge of electric machines, traction systems, and battery integration

  • Experience in system engineering, architecture design, and complex system integration

  • Exposure to heavy-duty vehicles, mining equipment, or off-highway applications is strongly preferred

  • Strong stakeholder management skills with experience operating in global matrix organizations

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.


ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the deployment of the quality strategy for a local organizational unit, including quality culture, systems, tools, and skilled teams, with the aim to meet customer expectations while ensuring sustainable operations. Each day, you will assist the organization in creating the right mix of prevention, continuous improvement, robust root cause analysis, quick response, and sustainable solutions to problems. You will also showcase your skills by collaborating with local functions that improve the quality of results to reach the targets for the organizational unit and aim for world-class performance.

The work model for the role is onsite. #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Power Protection, Smart Power division in Quartino, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Non-Conformities Management: Analyze non-conformities systematically to identify root causes and initiate cases in the Practical Problem Solving (PPS) tool to track corrective activities and ensure resolution.

  • PPS cases Management: Define containment, corrective, and preventive actions. Facilitate Level 2 Quality Circles and escalate critical cases to Level 3 when necessary.

  • Quality KPI Performance: contribute to the improvement of key quality metrics including First Pass Yield (FPY) manufacturing, Supplier PPM, Customer DPU, and overall Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ). Monitor and ensure timely closure of PPS cases.

  • Supplier Quality Management: Manage supplier non-conformities and identify top critical issues in collaboration with the Supplier Quality Manager to improve initiatives.

  • Production Support: Support Quality Technicians by identifying improvement opportunities to prevent non-conformities and minimize production disruptions.

  • Quality Gates Development: Develop new quality gates and continuously improve existing to enhance product quality and process control.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor's degree or SSST in Electrical Engineering or related field.

  • Minimum five years of experience in quality or equivalent role.

  • Deep understanding of quality processes, including problem-solving methodologies and continuous improvement tools.

  • Communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels. Willingness to work beyond standard hours when required and ability to perform efficiently in demanding situations.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage tasks efficiently and collaboratively in a constantly evolving manufacturing environment characterized by regular adjustments and shifts.

  • Fluency in English and Italian (written and spoken).

  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification is considered an advantage.



More about us

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

The recruitment process is led by Julia Farin, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

In questo ruolo, avrete l'opportunità di supportare l'implementazione della strategia di qualità per un'unità organizzativa locale, compresa la cultura di qualità, sistemi, strumenti e team qualificati, con l'obiettivo di soddisfare le aspettative dei clienti garantendo al contempo operazioni sostenibili. Ogni giorno, assisterai l'organizzazione nella creazione del giusto mix di prevenzione, miglioramento continuo, robusta analisi delle cause root, risposta rapida e soluzioni sostenibili ai problemi.

Potrai inoltre mostrare le tue competenze collaborando con funzioni locali che migliorano la qualità dei risultati per raggiungere gli obiettivi dell'unità organizzativa e puntare a performance di livello mondiale.

Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è in loco. #LI-Onsite

Questo ruolo contribuisce alla Power Protection, divisione Smart Power a Quartino, Svizzera.

Sarete responsabili principalmente di:

- Gestione delle non-conformità: analizzare sistematicamente le non-conformità per identificare le cause della radice e avviare casi nello strumento PPS (Practical Problem Solving) per monitorare le attività correttive e garantire la risoluzione.

- PPS casi Gestione: Definire azioni di contenimento, correttivo e preventivo. Facilitare Circles di qualità di livello 2 e aumentare i casi critici a livello 3 quando necessario.

- Prestazioni KPI di qualità: contribuire al miglioramento delle metriche di qualità chiave tra cui la produzione First Pass Read (FPY), il fornitore PPM, la DPU del cliente e il costo complessivo di scarsa qualità (COPQ). Monitor e garantire la chiusura tempestiva dei casi PPS.

- Gestione qualità fornitore: Gestire il fornitore non conformità e identificare i principali problemi critici in collaborazione con il responsabile qualità fornitore per migliorare le iniziative.

- Supporto alla produzione: Supporto alla Qualità TechNICans individuando opportunità di miglioramento per prevenire non conformità e ridurre al minimo le interruzioni della produzione.

- Sviluppo di Cancelli di Qualità: Sviluppare nuovi cancelli di qualità e migliorare continuamente la qualità dei prodotti e il controllo dei processi.

• Qualificazioni per il ruolo

- Laurea o SSST in Ingegneria Elettrica o campo correlato.

- minimo cinque anni di esperienza in qualità o ruolo equivalente.

- Conoscenza approfondita dei processi di qualità, comprese metodologie di risoluzione dei problemi e strumenti di miglioramento continuo.

- Comunicazione e capacità interpersonali con la capacità di impegnarsi efficacemente con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli organizzativi. Volontà di lavorare oltre le ore standard quando richiesto e capacità di eseguire efficacemente in situazioni difficili.

- Capacità dimostrativa di gestire le attività in modo efficiente e collaborativo in un ambiente produttivo in continua evoluzione caratterizzato da regolazioni e turni regolari.

- Fluenza in inglese e italiano (scritto e parlato).

- La certificazione Lean Six Sigma Green Belt è considerata un vantaggio.

Più su di noi

ABB Smart Power è leader mondiale nella tecnologia, con prodotti e soluzioni che rendono gli alimentatori intelligenti, collegati e protetti. I suoi prodotti e soluzioni intelligenti rendono l'energia più competitiva migliorando l'efficienza energetica, la produttività e l'affidabilità di quasi ogni operazione.

Abbiamo apprezzato persone provenienti da diversi background. Potrebbe essere questa la vostra storia? Applica oggi o visita www.abb.com per saperne di più su di noi e conoscere l'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

Il processo di reclutamento è guidato da Julia Farina, Partner di Globale, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede ogni tipo di mente: il curioso, il coraggioso e il creativo. Ecco perché accogliamo persone provenienti da ogni provenienza ed esperienza.

Pronto a fare un impatto?

Applica oggi o visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die Einführung der Qualitätsstrategie für eine lokale Organisationseinheit zu unterstützen, einschließlich Qualitätskultur, Systeme, Werkzeuge und qualifizierte Teams, mit dem Ziel, die Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen und gleichzeitig nachhaltiges Arbeiten zu gewährleisten. - Non-Conformities Management : Analyse von Nicht-Konformitäten systematisch, um die Ursachen zu identifizieren und Fälle im praktischen Problemlösungs-Tool (PPS) zu initiieren, um Korrekturmaßnahmen zu verfolgen und die Lösung zu gewährleisten.

- KKS-Fälle Management: Definieren Sie Eindämmungs-, Korrektur- und Präventivmaßnahmen. Facilitate Level 2 Qualitätskreise und eskalieren kritische Fälle, wenn nötig, auf Level 3.

- Qualität KPI Leistung : Beitrag zur Verbesserung der wichtigsten Qualitätsmetriken einschließlich First Pass Yield (FPY) Herstellung, Lieferant PPM, Kunde DPU, und Gesamtkosten für schlechte Qualität (COPQ). Überwachen und gewährleisten Sie rechtzeitige Schließung von PPS-Fällen.

- Lieferanten-Qualitätsmanagement : Verwalten Lieferanten-Nicht-Konformitäten und identifizieren Top-kritischen Fragen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Lieferanten-Qualitätsmanager, um Initiativen zu verbessern.

- Produktionsunterstützung: Unterstützung von Qualitätstechnikern durch die Ermittlung von Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten, um Nichtkonformitäten zu vermeiden und Produktionsunterbrechungen zu minimieren.

- Quality Gates Entwicklung : Entwicklung neuer Qualitätstore und kontinuierlich verbessern bestehende, um die Produktqualität und Prozesskontrolle zu verbessern.

- Bachelor-Abschluss oder SSST in Elektrotechnik oder verwandten Bereich.

- Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in Qualität oder gleichwertiger Rolle.

- Vertiefung des Verständnisses von Qualitätsprozessen, einschließlich Problemlösungsmethoden und kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinstrumente.

- Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Stakeholdern auf allen organisatorischen Ebenen zu engagieren. Bereitschaft, über die Standardstunden hinaus zu arbeiten, wenn erforderlich und Fähigkeit, effizient in anspruchsvollen Situationen zu arbeiten.

Vous pourrez également mettre en valeur vos compétences en collaborant avec des fonctions locales qui améliorent la qualité des résultats pour atteindre les objectifs de l'unité organisationnelle et viser des performances de classe mondiale.

This position reports to:

Agile Unit Leader Solutions

__

The Application Engineering Chapter Leader drives and continuously advances application expertise for the Critical Power business within ABB Electrification Smart Power (ELSP). This role is responsible for establishing and sharing best practices, standards, and domain know-how that enable customer and market requirements to be translated into optimized solutions and compelling value propositions. Through coaching, mentoring, and capability development, the Chapter Leader fosters a high-performing team of application engineering professionals.

The role leads the development of standards, tools, frameworks, and guidelines that enable efficient solution design, product selection, and adaptation to diverse customer needs. Working closely with Sales and other stakeholders, the Chapter Leader builds competencies across applications, solution architectures, market segments, channels, and value proposition development to support effective solution positioning and business growth.

In addition, the Chapter Leader owns and evolves key knowledge assets, including use cases, reference architectures, technical documentation, and reusable solution frameworks for the Critical Power portfolio. By fostering collaboration and knowledge exchange across Sales, Product Management, R&D, and Agile Units, the role ensures customer needs, emerging use cases, and market insights are captured, shared, and leveraged to support portfolio evolution, innovation priorities, and future product development.

This is a global role with preferred hiring locations in Quartino (Switzerland), Heidelberg (Germany), and Bergamo (Italy). The working model is hybrid.

Roles and • Responsibilities

  • Ensure the Application Engineering Chapter mission is delivered.
  • Act as a coach and subject matter expert, developing chapter members' competencies and skills.
  • Lead chapter alignment meetings, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities.
  • Build and nurture expertise in applications, solution architectures, market segments, channels, and customer value propositions for the Critical Power (ELSP) portfolio.
  • Develop and maintain standards, methods, tools, and best practices for application engineering.
  • Own and continuously evolve application knowledge, key use cases, reference architectures, technical documentation, and reusable solution frameworks.
  • Drive continuous learning and awareness of customer needs, market trends, competitive positioning, and segment dynamics within the chapter.
  • Ensure chapter members are equipped to identify and communicate customer needs, application trends, and market insights across the organization.
  • Promote effective collaboration and knowledge exchange with Sales, Product Management, R&D, and other Agile Units.
  • Lead recruitment, staffing, performance management, and career development of chapter members.

Preferred • Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Energy Systems, or equivalent.
  • Proven experience in Critical Power, UPS, Energy Storage, Power Conversion, or related applications.
  • Strong understanding of applications, solution architectures, market segments, channel dynamics, and emerging market trends.
  • Proven ability to translate customer requirements and application challenges into differentiated solutions and compelling value propositions aligned with Critical Power business strategy.
  • Experience supporting Sales organizations through technical consulting, customer engagement, and channel enablement.
  • Proven leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities.
  • Experience defining standards, methodologies, tools, and best practices within a technical organization.
  • Strong ability to operate and influence across complex stakeholder networks, including EPCs, consultants, end customers, channel partners, Sales, Product Management, and R&D.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with proven ability to engage customers, understand application challenges, and articulate value-driven solutions.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Agile Unit Leader Solutions

The Application Engineering Chapter Leader drives and continuous application expertise for the Critical Power business within ABB Electrification Smart Power (ELSP). Diese Rolle ist für die Etablierung und den Austausch von Best Practices, Standards und Domain-Know-how verantwortlich, die es ermöglichen, Kunden- und Marktanforderungen in optimierte Lösungen und überzeugende Wertversprechen umzusetzen. Durch Coaching, Mentoring und Fähigkeitsentwicklung fördert der Chapter Leader ein leistungsstarkes Team von Anwendungstechnikern.

Die Rolle leitet die Entwicklung von Standards, Tools, Frameworks und Richtlinien, die effizientes Lösungsdesign, Produktauswahl und Anpassung an unterschiedliche Kundenbedürfnisse ermöglichen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertrieb und anderen Interessengruppen baut der Chapter Leader Kompetenzen für Anwendungen, Lösungsarchitekturen, Marktsegmente, Kanäle und die Entwicklung von Wertversprechen auf, um eine effektive Lösungspositionierung und Geschäftswachstum zu unterstützen.

Darüber hinaus besitzt und entwickelt der Chapter Leader wichtige Wissensressourcen, darunter Anwendungsfälle, Referenzarchitekturen, technische Dokumentation und wiederverwendbare Lösungsrahmen für das Critical Power-Portfolio. Durch die Förderung der Zusammenarbeit und des Wissensaustauschs in den Bereichen Sales, Product Management, R&D und Agile Units stellt die Rolle sicher, dass Kundenbedürfnisse, aufkommende Anwendungsfälle und Markteinblicke erfasst, geteilt und genutzt werden, um die Portfolioentwicklung, Innovationsprioritäten und die zukünftige Produktentwicklung zu unterstützen.

>

>

>

>

>

  • Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Mission des Application Engineering Chapters erfüllt wird.

  • Leitung von Kapitelausrichtungssitzungen, Schulungen und Aktivitäten zum Wissensaustausch.
  • Aufbau und Pflege von Fachwissen in Anwendungen, Lösungsarchitekturen, Marktsegmenten, Kanälen und Kundennutzenangeboten für das Portfolio von Critical Power (ELSP).
  • Entwicklung und Pflege von Standards, Methoden, Tools und Best Practices für das Application Engineering.
  • Eigenes und kontinuierlich weiterentwickeltes Anwendungswissen, wichtige Anwendungsfälle, Referenzarchitekturen, technische Dokumentation und wiederverwendbare Lösungsframeworks.

  • Lead Rekrutierung, Personal, Performance Management und Karriereentwicklung der Kapitelmitglieder.

Bevorzugt • Qualifikationen

  • Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Leistungselektronik, Energiesysteme oder gleichwertig.
  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Critical Power, USV, Energy Storage, Power Conversion oder verwandten Anwendungen.
  • Starkes Verständnis von Anwendungen, Lösungsarchitekturen, Marktsegmenten, Kanaldynamik und aufstrebenden Markttrends.
  • Bewährte Fähigkeit, Kundenanforderungen und Anwendungsherausforderungen in differenzierte Lösungen und überzeugende Wertversprechen zu übersetzen, die an der Geschäftsstrategie von Critical Power ausgerichtet sind.

  • Erfahrung mit der Definition von Standards, Methoden, Tools und Best Practices innerhalb einer technischen Organisation.
  • Starke Fähigkeit, über komplexe Stakeholder-Netzwerke hinweg zu operieren und Einfluss zu nehmen, darunter EPCs, Berater, Endkunden, Channel-Partner, Vertrieb, Produktmanagement und F&E.

jobs.title: R&D (Senior)Testing & Lab Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A young, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Own the lab infrastructure (Laborinfrastruktur), including coordination with maintenance (Instandhaltung), organizing calibration (Kalibrierung) of equipment, and managing lab supplies (Verbrauchsmaterialien).
  • Ensure lab safety (Sicherheit) and organize/structure lab spaces for multiple ongoing projects.
  • Support scientific work by designing and building power electronics prototypes (Leistungselektronik Prototypen) up to medium voltage (Mittelspannung) and megawatt power.
  • Assist in commissioning test setups (Inbetriebnahme von Prüfaufbauten) and perform testing together with scientific staff (Wissenschaftler).
  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders (Teamfähigkeit), and supervise apprentices (Lernende / Auszubildende) in daily tasks.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician (Automatiker EFZ) with practical experience in machining (Fräsen, Bohren, Drehen, Handarbeit), and be able to conversate in English.
  • Additional education from a Higher Technical School or University of Applied Sciences (Höhere Fachschule HF / Fachhochschule FH) in power electronics, energy systems, or similar is a strong advantage.
  • Experience with CAD design (CAD-Konstruktion) using tools such as Creo, Solid Edge, SolidWorks, or equivalent; PCB design (Leiterplattendesign) knowledge is a plus (Altium Designer).
  • Solid experience in electrical circuit design (Schaltungsdesign), grounding concepts (Erdung), and wiring standards (Verdrahtungsrichtlinien).
  • Hands-on experience building and prototyping power electronic systems (Leistungselektronik Systeme), including mechanical work, tooling (Werkzeuge), and implementing ad-hoc improvements.
  • Basic knowledge of electrical standards (e.g., NIV / NIN / SNR 464022) and familiarity with lab technologies such as 3D printing (3D-Druck), LabVIEW, and laser cutting/engraving (Laserschneider / Lasergravur).

More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A young, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Own the lab infrastructure (Laborinfrastruktur), including coordination with maintenance (Instandhaltung), organizing calibration (Kalibrierung) of equipment, and managing lab supplies (Verbrauchsmaterialien).
  • Ensure lab safety (Sicherheit) and organize/structure lab spaces for multiple ongoing projects.
  • Support scientific work by designing and building power electronics prototypes (Leistungselektronik Prototypen) up to medium voltage (Mittelspannung) and megawatt power.
  • Assist in commissioning test setups (Inbetriebnahme von Prüfaufbauten) and perform testing together with scientific staff (Wissenschaftler).
  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders (Teamfähigkeit), and supervise apprentices (Lernende / Auszubildende) in daily tasks.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician (Automatiker EFZ) with practical experience in machining (Fräsen, Bohren, Drehen, Handarbeit), and be able to conversate in English.
  • Additional education from a Higher Technical School or University of Applied Sciences (Höhere Fachschule HF / Fachhochschule FH) in power electronics, energy systems, or similar is a strong advantage.
  • Experience with CAD design (CAD-Konstruktion) using tools such as Creo, Solid Edge, SolidWorks, or equivalent; PCB design (Leiterplattendesign) knowledge is a plus (Altium Designer).
  • Solid experience in electrical circuit design (Schaltungsdesign), grounding concepts (Erdung), and wiring standards (Verdrahtungsrichtlinien).
  • Hands-on experience building and prototyping power electronic systems (Leistungselektronik Systeme), including mechanical work, tooling (Werkzeuge), and implementing ad-hoc improvements.
  • Basic knowledge of electrical standards (e.g., NIV / NIN / SNR 464022) and familiarity with lab technologies such as 3D printing (3D-Druck), LabVIEW, and laser cutting/engraving (Laserschneider / Lasergravur).

More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Maintenance Specialist
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Manager Production Development

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will lead processes that safeguard the efficiency, reliability, and performance of automated production equipment, production lines, and facilities across a dynamic manufacturing environment. This includes our new, state-of-the-art automated battery pack plant, complementing our established battery module and pack lines as well as converter lines. You will ensure that maintenance strategies, technical documentation, and improvement initiatives drive high availability, operational excellence, and the best possible use of technical and financial resources. The role also calls for close collaboration with production engineering to strengthen team redundancy while continuously advancing highly automated manufacturing processes.

The work model for the role is: onsite

This role is contributing to the Traction Operations in Untersiggenthal and Baden. Main stakeholders are ABB Energy Storage Systems and Converter Production.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Partial or full leadership of the Traction Operations maintenance group, coordinating maintenance activities and supporting group performance and development.

  • Defining and implementing maintenance strategies and plans for automated production lines, improving reliability, maintainability, and safety of equipment and facilities.

  • Introducing, developing, and maintaining CMMS tools while ensuring accurate and up-to-date technical documentation of production equipment and systems.

  • Troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues in automated production lines to ensure high availability and stable production performance.

  • Driving continuous improvement initiatives by proposing and implementing projects that optimize production processes, reduce maintenance needs, and enhance operational efficiency in very close collaboration with production development engineers.



You will join an ambitious and high-performing production development team operating highly automated systems. Collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement are key to our success.



• Qualifications for the role

  • Strong experience in industrial maintenance of automated production equipment, including electrical, mechanical, and automation systems

  • Solid knowledge of automation technologies such as PLC programming, robotics, sensors, industrial communication networks, and automated production systems

  • Experience with maintenance concepts, troubleshooting, CMMS systems, machine diagnostics, and reliability improvement methodologies (e.g., OEE optimization, lean manufacturing)

  • Understanding of production engineering principles, or willingness and motivation to learn and contribute to production engineering topics to ensure team redundancy and cross-functional support

  • Proven qualification in Electrical Engineering, Automation Technology, Mechatronics, or a comparable technical field, or equivalent hands-on industrial experience

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable technical improvements

  • You are at ease communicating in German


More about us

The ABB Traction Division is a recognized market leader in drive technologies for rail vehicles, buses, and industrial vehicles, driving innovation in electrification.

Our comprehensive portfolio of high-performance traction, auxiliary, and energy storage solutions – all managed across the entire life cycle – helps to improve energy efficiency and make transportation more sustainable.

Together, we make a difference for our customers every single day. We look forward to receiving your application.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: onsite

Diese Rolle trägt zu den Traction Operations in Untersiggenthal und Baden bei. Hauptakteure sind ABB Energy Storage Systems und Converter Production.

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Teilweise oder vollständige Führung der Wartungsgruppe Traction Operations, Koordination der Wartungsaktivitäten und Unterstützung der Leistung und Entwicklung der Gruppe.

  • Einführung, Entwicklung und Wartung von CMMS-Tools bei gleichzeitiger Gewährleistung einer genauen und aktuellen technischen Dokumentation von Produktionsanlagen und -systemen.

  • Troubleshooting und Behebung komplexer technischer Probleme in automatisierten Produktionslinien, um eine hohe Verfügbarkeit und stabile Produktionsleistung zu gewährleisten.

  • Nachgewiesene Qualifikation in Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Mechatronik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich oder gleichwertige praktische Industrieerfahrung

  • Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Ursachen zu erkennen und nachhaltige technische Verbesserungen umzusetzen

Cette position fait rapport à:

Gestionnaire Développement de la production

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des processus qui garantissent l'efficacité, la fiabilité et la performance des équipements de production automatisés, des lignes de production et des installations dans un environnement de fabrication dynamique. Il s'agit de notre nouvelle centrale de batteries automatisées à la fine pointe de la technologie, qui complète notre module de batteries et nos lignes de batteries ainsi que nos lignes de convertisseur. Vous veillerez à ce que les stratégies de maintenance, la documentation technique et les initiatives d'amélioration favorisent une grande disponibilité, l'excellence opérationnelle et la meilleure utilisation possible des ressources techniques et financières. Le rôle exige également une collaboration étroite avec l'ingénierie de production pour renforcer la redondance d'équipe tout en faisant progresser les processus de fabrication hautement automatisés.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : sur place

Ce rôle contribue aux opérations de traction à Untersiggenthal et à Baden. Les principaux intervenants sont ABB Energy Storage Systems and Converter Production.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Le leadership partiel ou complet du groupe de maintenance des opérations de traction, la coordination des activités de maintenance et l'appui au rendement et au développement du groupe.

  • Définir et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies et des plans d'entretien des lignes de production automatisées, en améliorant la fiabilité, la maintenance et la sécurité de l'équipement et des installations.

  • Introduction, mise au point et entretien d'outils du SGCM tout en assurant une documentation technique exacte et à jour de l'équipement et des systèmes de production.

  • Dépannage et résolution de problèmes techniques complexes dans les lignes de production automatisées afin d'assurer une grande disponibilité et une performance de production stable.

  • Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue en proposant et en mettant en oeuvre des projets qui optimisent les processus de production, réduisent les besoins de maintenance et améliorent l'efficacité opérationnelle en collaboration très étroite avec les ingénieurs de développement de la production. Vous rejoindrez une équipe de développement de production ambitieuse et performante qui exploite des systèmes hautement automatisés. La collaboration, l'excellence technique et l'amélioration continue sont essentielles à notre succès.



    • Qualifications pour le rôle

    • Fort expérience dans l'entretien industriel du matériel de production automatisé, y compris les systèmes électriques, mécaniques et d'automatisation

    • Connaissance approfondie des technologies d'automatisation telles que la programmation de PLC, la robotique, les capteurs, les réseaux de communication industrielle et les systèmes de production automatisés

    • Expérience des concepts de maintenance, du dépannage, des systèmes CMMS, du diagnostic des machines et des méthodes d'amélioration de la fiabilité (p. ex. optimisation de l'OEE, fabrication maigre)

    • Compréhension des principes d'ingénierie de la production, ou volonté et motivation d'apprendre et de contribuer aux sujets d'ingénierie de la production afin d'assurer la redondance de l'équipe et le soutien interfonctionnel

    • Qualification éprouvée en génie électrique, en technologie d'automatisation, en mécatronique ou dans un domaine technique comparable, ou expérience industrielle pratique équivalente

    • Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec la capacité d'identifier les causes profondes et de mettre en oeuvre des améliorations techniques durables

    • Vous êtes à l'aise de communiquer en allemand


    Plus d'information sur nous

    La Division de la traction de l'ABB est un chef de file reconnu sur le marché des technologies d'entraînement pour les véhicules ferroviaires, les autobus et les véhicules industriels, et de l'innovation dans l'électrification.

    Notre portefeuille complet de solutions de traction, auxiliaires et de stockage d'énergie de haute performance – toutes gérées tout au long du cycle de vie – contribue à améliorer l'efficacité énergétique et à rendre le transport plus durable.

    Ensemble, nous faisons une différence pour nos clients tous les jours. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre demande.

    Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

    Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.title: Business & Market Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Strategy Manager

__

Do you enjoy translating data into useful insights that support strategic decision-making? Join our team as an Electrification Business & Market Intelligence Analyst, where you’ll analyze market trends, provide competitor insights, and uncover growth opportunities around the world. You’ll collaborate with the global leadership team to shape strategic initiatives and ensure market transparency.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid or #LI-remote

This role is contributing to Electrification Business Area Strategy, Business & Market Research team

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Market intelligence processes: Improve existing and define new scalable processes for collecting, validating, and synthesizing market insights from a global sales organization, incl. encouraging adoption and developing reporting frameworks and dashboards for senior leadership

  • Market & Competitor Intelligence: Track and evaluate global market trends, uncovering gaps and opportunities for growth. Deliver compelling analyses to guide management decisions and fuel business growth.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to ensure the high-quality delivery and integration of business intelligence into decision-making processes

  • Data-Driven Strategy: Collect and analyze market, competitor, and financial data to provide high-quality insights that support key business decisions and strategic planning.

  • Innovation in Tools & Analytics: System administration of Business Intelligence Tools in Electrification, developing and enhancing business intelligence tools, such as Power BI, and support marketing teams globally by ensuring optimal use of sales tracking systems and data quality.

  • Continuous Improvement: Propose and apply enhancements to business analysis tools so the organization can collect, interpret, and use intelligence more effectively

• Qualifications for the role:

  • 5–7+ years of experience in market intelligence, business insights, or related functions.

  • Demonstrated experience building intelligence and designing processes that scale across large organizations and working effectively in multinational organizations with geographically dispersed teams.

  • Demonstrated skill in stakeholder management, including work alongside commercial leaders across regions and business units

  • Solid analytical capabilities, including experience with data analysis, visualization, and insight generation, with a talent for identifying trends and making strategic recommendations

  • Clear, concise communication and engaging storytelling capabilities

  • Ability to combine strategic thinking with practical execution

  • Proficiency in business intelligence tools like MS Office Suite, Anaplan, Power BI, ThinkCell and other market research platforms

  • A results-focused attitude with a commitment to continuous improvement.

  • Experience with market intelligence, analytics, or business intelligence tools.

  • Knowledge of AI-enabled research, text analytics, or insight-generation tools is a strong plus.

  • For Switzerland location: candidates must bel eligible to work in Switzerland. Visa sponsorship is not offered for this position.

Why You’ll Enjoy Working Here

  • You will join a collaborative team, where you will be able to thrive.

  • Strategic Work: Your insights will directly influence strategic decisions and contribute to the growth of the business on a global scale

  • Innovative Environment: Work with up-to-date tools and technologies to support meaningful business improvements

  • Global Collaboration: Collaborate with teams from across the globe, ensuring diverse perspectives and a global mindset in everything you do.

  • Professional Growth: Be part of a forward-thinking team that encourages continuous learning and development, with opportunities to grow within the organization.

Take the next step by joining our team and helping advance our business with innovative market intelligence and strategic insights.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, was die Welt beherrscht.

Genießen Sie es, Daten in nützliche Erkenntnisse zu übersetzen, die die strategische Entscheidungsfindung unterstützen? Treten Sie unserem Team als Electrification Business & Market Intelligence Analyst bei, wo Sie Markttrends analysieren, Einblicke in Wettbewerber geben und Wachstumschancen auf der ganzen Welt entdecken. Sie arbeiten mit dem globalen Führungsteam zusammen, um strategische Initiativen zu gestalten und Markttransparenz zu gewährleisten.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle lautet: #LI-hybrid oder #LI-remote

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Market Intelligence Processes: Verbessern Sie bestehende und definieren Sie neue skalierbare Prozesse zum Sammeln, Validieren und Synthetisieren von Marktinformationen aus einer globalen Vertriebsorganisation, einschließlich der Förderung der Einführung und Entwicklung von Berichtsrahmen und Dashboards für Führungskräfte

  • Market & Competitor Intelligence: Verfolgen und bewerten Sie globale Markttrends und decken Sie Lücken und Wachstumschancen auf. Liefern Sie überzeugende Analysen, um Managemententscheidungen zu leiten und das Geschäftswachstum anzukurbeln.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Stakeholdern und externen Lieferanten zusammen, um die qualitativ hochwertige Bereitstellung und Integration von Business Intelligence in Entscheidungsprozesse zu gewährleisten

  • Data-Driven Strategy: Sammeln und Analysieren Sie Markt-, Wettbewerber- und Finanzdaten, um qualitativ hochwertige Erkenntnisse zu liefern, die wichtige Geschäftsentscheidungen und strategische Planung unterstützen.

  • Innovation in Tools & Analytics: Systemadministration von Business Intelligence Tools in der Elektrifizierung, Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Business Intelligence Tools wie Power BI und Unterstützung von Marketingteams weltweit durch optimale Nutzung von Sales Tracking Systemen und Datenqualität.

  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Verbesserung von Business-Analyse-Tools vorschlagen und anwenden, damit das Unternehmen Informationen effektiver sammeln, interpretieren und nutzen kann

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • 5–7+ Jahre Erfahrung in Market Intelligence, Business Insights oder verwandten Funktionen.

  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung beim Aufbau von Intelligenz und bei der Gestaltung von Prozessen, die sich über große Organisationen erstrecken und effektiv in multinationalen Organisationen mit geografisch verteilten Teams arbeiten.

  • Demonstrierte Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management, einschließlich der Zusammenarbeit mit kaufmännischen Führungskräften in Regionen und Geschäftseinheiten

  • Solide analytische Fähigkeiten, einschließlich Erfahrung mit Datenanalyse, Visualisierung und Einblicksgenerierung, mit einem Talent für die Identifizierung von Trends und strategische Empfehlungen

  • Klare, prägnante Kommunikation und ansprechende Storytelling-Fähigkeiten

  • Fähigkeit, strategisches Denken mit praktischer Ausführung zu kombinieren

  • Kenntnisse in Business-Intelligence-Tools wie MS Office Suite, Anaplan, Power BI, ThinkCell und anderen Marktforschungsplattformen

  • Eine ergebnisorientierte Einstellung mit dem Engagement für kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

  • Erfahrung mit Market Intelligence, Analytics oder Business Intelligence Tools.

  • Kenntnisse über KI-fähige Forschung, Textanalysen oder Insight-Generierungs-Tools sind ein starkes Plus.

  • Für den Standort Schweiz: Kandidaten müssen in der Schweiz arbeiten können. Visa-Sponsoring wird für diese Position nicht angeboten.

Why Youll Enjoy Working Here

  • Sie werden einem kollaborativen Team beitreten, in dem Sie gedeihen können.

  • Strategische Arbeit: Ihre Erkenntnisse werden strategische Entscheidungen direkt beeinflussen und zum Wachstum des Unternehmens auf globaler Ebene beitragen

  • Innovative Environment: Arbeiten Sie mit aktuellen Tools und Technologien, um sinnvolle Geschäftsverbesserungen zu unterstützen

  • Global Collaboration: Arbeiten Sie mit Teams aus der ganzen Welt zusammen und gewährleisten Sie bei allem, was Sie tun, vielfältige Perspektiven und eine globale Denkweise.

  • Professionelles Wachstum: Werden Sie Teil eines zukunftsorientierten Teams, das kontinuierliches Lernen und Entwicklung fördert, mit Wachstumsmöglichkeiten innerhalb der Organisation. Cette position se rapporte à:

Strategy Manager

Aimez-vous traduire les données en informations utiles qui appuient la prise de décisions stratégiques? Rejoignez notre équipe en tant qu'analyste de l'intelligence d'entreprise et de marché pour l'électrification, où vous analyserez les tendances du marché, fournirez des idées aux concurrents et découvrirez des opportunités de croissance dans le monde entier. Vous collaborerez avec l'équipe de direction mondiale pour façonner les initiatives stratégiques et assurer la transparence du marché.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #LI-hybrid ou #LI-remote

Ce rôle contribue à l'équipe de la Stratégie du secteur d'activité de l'électrification, de la Recherche sur les affaires et les marchés

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Processus de renseignements commerciaux: Améliorer et définir de nouveaux processus évolutifs pour recueillir, valider et synthétiser les points de vue commerciaux d'une organisation de vente mondiale, y compris encourager l'adoption et l'élaboration de cadres de rapport et de tableaux de bord pour les cadres supérieurs

• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • 5–7+ ans d'expérience dans le domaine de l'intelligence du marché, des connaissances commerciales ou des fonctions connexes.

  • Expérience démontrée en matière de renforcement du renseignement et de conception de processus à l'échelle des grandes organisations et en travaillant efficacement dans des organisations multinationales avec des équipes géographiquement dispersées.

  • Capacités analytiques solides, y compris l'expérience de l'analyse des données, de la visualisation et de la production de renseignements, avec un talent pour identifier les tendances et faire des recommandations stratégiques

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Business Line Manager - Mining & Materials

__

As Global Sales Manager for Business Line Mining & Materials, you will lead the global sales function and serve as a member of the Business Line Management Team. You will be responsible for defining and executing the commercial strategy across all BL Mining & Materials businesses, driving profitable growth, strategic account development, market expansion and commercial excellence worldwide. Working closely with business unit leaders, cluster managers and country sales organizations, you will shape ABB’s commercial success in the mining, cement and battery materials industries.

This role reports to Bjorn Jonsson, Business Line Manager, Mining & Materials.

Role & • Responsibilities

In this role, you will have overall responsibility for the global sales organization of Business Line Mining & Materials, leading the commercial agenda across all regions and business units. You will develop and execute the global sales strategy, build and coach an international sales leadership team, and ensure alignment between business priorities, customer needs and growth opportunities. As a member of the BL Management Team, you will play a key role in shaping the strategic direction and long-term success of the business.

  • Leading the global BL Mining & Materials sales function and driving performance, capability development and engagement across the organization.

  • Driving the overall commercial strategy and achieving targets for orders, revenue, profitability, market share and customer satisfaction.

  • Building executive-level relationships with strategic customers, EPCs and industry partners while overseeing major commercial opportunities and negotiations.

  • Partnering with Business Unit Managers, Cluster Managers and Functional Leaders to maximize growth opportunities across the global portfolio.

About Business Line Mining & Materials

Business Line Mining & Materials is part of ABB Process Industries and serves customers in the Mining, Cement and Battery Materials industries. With approximately 2,000 employees across 28 countries, the business is a market leader in application-specific solutions and delivers integrated electrification, automation, digitalization and service offerings across the entire customer value chain. Our mission is to help customers outrun – safer, leaner and cleaner – through technology leadership and deep industry expertise

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Anticipating and identifying the shortfalls in performance and takes appropriate remedial actions, proactively.

  • Identifying and evaluating new opportunities with existing and potential customers, determines plans for implementation, and allocates required resources.

  • Planning and executing customer surveys and acts on the survey results to ensure high level of customer satisfaction.

  • Participating in the negotiation of key contracts.

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing or a related field.

  • Significant experience in global sales leadership, business development or commercial management within mining, process industries, automation, electrification or related sectors.

  • Demonstrated success in developing and executing growth strategies across international markets.

  • Strong leadership capabilities with experience leading global and culturally diverse teams.

  • Excellent commercial acumen including strategic account management, negotiations and business planning.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior customer and business leaders.

  • Fluent in English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

What’s in it for You?

  • Opportunity to shape the commercial strategy and future growth of a globally recognized business line.

  • Exposure to some of the world’s leading mining, cement and battery materials companies.

  • Ability to influence the sustainability transformation of heavy industry through electrification, automation and digitalization.

  • Global career opportunities within ABB.

  • A collaborative international environment focused on innovation, inclusion and continuous learning.

Location

We are committed to hiring the best people to our team and for this global position we are actively hiring in our key cluster locations (Australia, Brazil, Canada, India, South Africa, Sweden, Switzerland)

More About Us

At ABB, we are dedicated to helping industries become more productive, resource-efficient and sustainable. Business Line Mining & Materials combines global technology leadership in electrification, automation and digitalization with deep application knowledge to deliver integrated solutions from mine to market. As Global Sales Manager, you will lead one of the most strategic functions within the Business Line and play a key role in shaping its future growth and market success.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
